title: eni shares fall fifth day amid italy windfall tax debate 2026 08 27
text:
MILAN, Aug 27 (Reuters) - Shares in Italian oil and gas group Eni (ENI.MI)
, opens new tab
 were down for a fifth consecutive day on Thursday ​amid speculation that the government could impose a windfall ‌tax on energy companies to help finance fuel-price cuts in response to the U.S.-Iran war.
